description: This file defines a static class for configuring dependency injection of services in a Blazor web application. It registers various catalog lookup data services and item services with the DI container, often wrapping them with cached decorator implementations.

classes.name: ServicesConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure and register application services in the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddBlazorServices
methods.description: An extension method that registers catalog lookup data services and catalog item services into the IServiceCollection with scoped lifetime, including both normal and cached decorator implementations.
